product_one_liner.value: D·engage is a customer-experience data and omnichannel marketing automation platform for brands and enterprises that unifies customer data and enables personalized journeys across channels such as email, SMS, push, and WhatsApp.
product_one_liner.notes: Describes the product and its intended business/brand users.

pricing_page.notes: Public page describes Core, Pro, and Enterprise plans, although exact prices are not published.

named_customers.notes: Names appear on the company's customer-stories page.

employee_band.notes: Gartner reports 51–200 employees; LinkedIn reports 51–200. The requested bins split this range, so the evidence cannot support an exact band. The nearest selected band is not reliably inferable; uncertainty noted.

hq_location.notes: Both company profile sources report London, United Kingdom as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains marketing, product announcement, and company/security posts; it does not show two engineering/technical posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public developer guide contains multiple documentation sections and integration documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Search results identify current technology roles including Full Stack Developer; no AI, ML, data-science, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision titled role was found. Careers page itself was not readable in the scrape; this negative determination is lower confidence.

model_provider.notes: No public statement naming an AI model or model provider was found in the searched product, documentation, blog, or security materials.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust Center lists these as certifications/compliance. Other listed badges not requested are omitted.

last_funding.notes: The company announced a strategic investment dated 2025-09-03, but did not disclose the amount. The schema requires a numeric amount; zero is a placeholder for undisclosed, not a claim that the round was free.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest located round was announced in September 2025, before the 18-month window starting 2025-05-09; no later round was found.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Search result career listing showed technology openings; none listed was SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive. Careers page itself was not readable in the scrape.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index shows feature-update announcements without publication dates. Since it cannot be established whether those entries were published within the six-month window, no true or false conclusion can be supported.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No sufficiently verifiable, dated executive join/departure announcement or full current team page was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public integration documentation names Microsoft Dynamics 365. Other documented platforms are not CRM/sales-marketing systems or were not included.
